brief:
The Quincy Institute has published an explanation of the Israel lobby's role in shaping U.S. foreign policy toward the Middle East. The resource examines how organized advocacy groups, political donations, and institutional relationships have affected American decision-making on Israel-related issues.

The material provides an overview of the mechanisms through which pro-Israel organizations operate within the American political system, according to the Quincy Institute. The analysis covers the lobby's structure, funding sources, and methods of influence on congressional and executive branch policymaking.
title: Quincy Institute explains influence of Israel lobby on U.S. policy
